status: Mechanism references and candidate directions, not a finalized R15E architecture

sources.title: MotiF: Making Text Count in Image Animation with Motion Focal Loss
sources.verified: Studies excessive reliance on the conditional image and reweights generation loss using RAFT motion heatmaps. Text alignment and visual-quality tradeoffs are reported, including misleading static-video metrics.
sources.relevance: Inspect whether valid physical priors suppress requested processes; revisit whether high-error reduction addresses the correct signals.
sources.limits: Do not substitute larger motion for physical quality; our phenomena include static optics/stability/deformation. No RAFT/model download or RGB-change objective has been authorized here. Their32K-step experiment does not predict our400-step results.

sources.title: Temporal-aware Flow Matching for Video Generation with Temporally Coherent Motion
sources.verified: Defines coupled frame-wise probability paths and a residual/direction loss. Official code numerically solves a tridiagonal system to generate training states/velocities; it is not just adjacent-frame MSE added to ordinary FM.
sources.relevance: Current generation objective pools scalar pointwise errors; it has no explicit error coupling across frames. Consider process-aware supervision while retaining useful physics fusion.
sources.limits: Standard video FM is not inherently incapable of learning temporal relations: the denoiser is joint. Full TFM changes training paths and targets, and its public implementation trains T2V Wan14B over much longer training. First-frame-fixed I2V requires a mathematically consistent boundary adaptation. Do not copy its residual loss while keeping incompatible straight-path targets.

sources.title: IP-Adapter
sources.verified: Separates image and text cross-attention while freezing the pretrained backbone.
sources.relevance: Preserve proven native text Q/K/V/O while investigating physical-read/write compatibility.
sources.limits: Decoupling alone has already failed to guarantee our SA/Joint; image adapter results do not prove a physics solution.

sources.title: GLIGEN: Open-Set Grounded Text-to-Image Generation
sources.verified: Official Transformer block applies self-attention, new grounding fuser, native text cross-attention, then FFN; pretrained parameters frozen. New grounding is thus consumed by a subsequent native text read.
sources.relevance: Candidate mechanism: let the unchanged native text pathway respond immediately to physical-updated visual states, instead of adding a large physical write after the native text update.
sources.limits: Grounded image-generation evidence, not a demonstration of short-trained video physics. Their gating and inference schedule are separate choices; do not assume we must copy either. Changing read/write order needs same-weight comparison and fresh-training quality tests.

current_evidence.R15B: 40 SA2.925 PC3.700 J10; direct-read16 SA3.125 PC4.000 J5 versus normal3.0625/3.8125/J6. Request binding has a real tradeoff, not established overall benefit.
current_evidence.R15C: 40 SA3.125 PC3.375 J10; a larger local video operator lost physical gains despite retaining the enhancement. Do not reuse it merely for parameter capacity.
current_evidence.R15D: Main40 SA3.000 PC3.575 J10; six16 complete. Normal16 SA3.25 PC3.875 J6; remainder24 SA2.8333 PC3.375 J4. Physics helps paired16 vs noC and correct reasoning helps, but main40 and real tool geometry remain deficient.

candidate_axes: Preserve direct C-value physical execution and useful state interaction unless new causal evidence contradicts them.
Test whether learned semantic routing and physical execution actually act compatibly with the unchanged native request pathway. Do not average physical values again without evidence.
Analyze conditional/no-C velocity differences and real write fields before choosing a replacement fusion design.
Consider generation-supervision changes that penalize incorrect target processes/structure without rewarding arbitrary motion or using benchmark evaluator scores as training targets.
ruled_out_shortcuts: Do not treat output commonality by itself as a defect: compare R1/R10A/R15B actual execution first.
Native O initialization has already been tried in R5-R8 (e.g.R7 nativeO*0.25, trainable); do not present this alone as a new solution.
R15D time-map-off/pretext controls differ by only1 PC point on16 and no SA/Joint points. They do not establish a robust new benefit or explain the outside16 regressions.
Do not infer full40 success from selected16 metrics; use both fixed16 and remaining24 failure evidence.
